description: Part 2, How often are disclosed directions wrong? (G-05): the six sites on score A (released error array; draws from their normal law, means and SDs of the released units table, through the seeded engine stream) and the theory book's three-unit finite law (ch. 10). The report 1/2/3/3/4/5 (the exact optimum within A_6 at tau = .20), the capped optimum 1/1/2/2/3/3, the strict order and the all-withheld report are six.A.* keys in part2.json, and the law's report 1/1/2 is tb10.law3.*; this fragment adds the prediction's rounded numbers, the largest stated error and tau N of the reports the page shows, and the Monte Carlo averages of the two seeds the page and its read-out cases use (seed 1 with 100 draws, seed 424242 with 5 draws; the average count is the E of the report under the draws' empirical law, drawErrors, which equals the mean of the per-draw counts).

g05.six.draws.seed1.S100.note: the deck preset's draws: 100 draws from the six sites' normal law, seed 1

g05.six.draws.seed1.S100.E.note: share of the 100 draws in which each stated direction is wrong

g05.six.draws.seed424242.S5.note: the same draws as the base-R row gaussianDraws-six-scoreA-sd.2-S5-seed424242 (oracle-stream)

g05.law3.note: theory book ch. 10: orders ABC 3/5, ACB 3/20, BAC 3/20, CBA 1/10 (the same input as tb10.law3)

g05.six.r123345.E2.note: E of 1/2/3/3/4/5 to two decimals, the prediction's choice 'about .36' (the same value as six.A.all.tau20.E)

g05.six.r123345.tau20.maxstated.note: the largest error among the stated directions of 1/2/3/3/4/5 (A above B)

g05.six.r123345.tau20.over.note: stated directions of 1/2/3/3/4/5 whose error exceeds tau = .20: none

g05.six.r112233.tau20.tauN.note: tau N of the capped optimum 1/1/2/2/3/3 (N = 12)

g05.six.r112233.tau20.maxstated.note: the largest error among the stated directions of 1/1/2/2/3/3 (D above E)

g05.six.r123456.E.note: the strict order states all 15 pairs

g05.six.r123456.tau20.maxstated.note: C above D, the one stated direction of the strict order whose error exceeds tau = .20

g05.six.r123456.tau20.risk.note: risk of the strict order at tau = .20: below tau, so E <= tau N holds for it although it is not the exact optimum of a family that contains the all-withheld report

g05.six.r123345.mc.seed1.S100.mean.note: Monte Carlo, 100 draws, seed 1: the average number of wrong stated directions of 1/2/3/3/4/5

g05.six.r123345.mc.seed1.S100.share.note: the same average divided by N = 14

g05.six.r123345.mc.seed424242.S5.mean.note: Monte Carlo, 5 draws, seed 424242 (the base-R draws of oracle-stream)

g05.six.r123345.mc.seed424242.S5.lastsha.note: their share of the 14 stated directions

g05.law3.r112.tau20.tauN.note: tau N of report 1/1/2 (N = 2): the theory book's bound E <= tau N, 7/20 <= 2/5

g05.law3.r112.CBA.wrong.note: order CBA (values 1, 2, 3 for A, B, C) makes both stated directions of 1/1/2 wrong

g05.law3.r112.ACB.wrong.note: order ACB makes B above C wrong

g05.law3.r123.E.note: the full order ABC states all three pairs

g05.law3.r111.EoverN.note: the law's all-withheld report: NA: no disclosure
